title: 第18章 干六碗粉
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 刘宇宁就定定等着刘烨和徐喜弟赶上来。五个人，各怀心思往镇上赶。圩日的确很热闹。他们路远，刚到街市，里边已经摆满了卖东西的农户。巴儿姐看到第一家卖粉的摊子，就坐那里不肯走。“哥，我们先吃碗粉再去逛吧。”张永福拍着刘宇宁的肩膀。五个人其实都没吃早饭，到了镇上都快中午了，于是各自拉了凳子坐下来。“阿婆，来十碗粉，加点瘦肉。”刘宇宁把张永福从背篓里抱出来，拉了一张小板凳安置他，叫了粉，从裤兜里掏了五块钱。“十碗？”老阿婆还以为自己的听错了，“四碗还是十碗？”“十碗。”刘宇宁再说了一次。老阿婆的数着人头，五个人，一人两碗。想想又不对，其中两个女的，一人最多一碗。一个瘦猴，也勉强一碗。她的粉，是街上份量给最足的粉摊了。还有两个壮汉，一个比另外一个略微壮一点。于是她主动地给他们做了分配。给刘烨四碗，刘宇宁三碗。村里干农活出来的糙汉，吃两碗的很常见，吃三碗的可少之又少。五人面前的小桌，让十碗粉挤得满满当当。路过的行人，都要忍不住多看一眼。看着刘宇宁把另外两碗，也推到刘烨面前……刘烨冲他憨憨一笑，全部笑纳，“谢了。”老阿婆小眼都瞪圆了。这位壮士，要一个人干六碗粉！她倒要看看，他怎么吃得完！刘烨也没让她失望，第一碗举起来，筷子在碗里卷了卷，紧接着狮子大张口。第一口卷完了粉，第二口喝干了汤。然后就是第二碗，步骤同样。这几年看惯了刘烨风卷残云的吃饭模样，几人都见怪不怪。徐喜弟被三人隔在最边上，离得远，她默默低头吃自己的。余光时不时扫过去。傻叔这六碗粉，也不知道几碗力气是用在她身上的。还有他那张大盆口，上下都没放过她……她没敢继续想，中午了，初夏的太阳着实有点热。才喝了一小口汤，就汗涔涔的，她想快点吃完，好站起来吹吹风。可老阿婆给的粉，份量十足，她吃了大半就有些吃不动了。刚站起来，刘烨隔着几人，目光精准地盯着她的碗。“喜弟，吃饱了？”“嗯。饱了。”徐喜弟有种不好的预感。“还剩那么多，别浪费啊。吃不完给叔吃。”刘烨说着，就伸长手过去。可是中间间隔了三个人，够不到，他碰了碰刘宇宁的胳膊。刘宇宁愣了愣，“哥，要不再点一碗？”“不，我已经饱了。就是见不得浪费粮食。”刘烨拒绝了他的好意。刘宇宁知道刘烨能吃，六碗差不多了。非要再来一碗，也不成问题。可是摊主老阿婆已经看呆了，周围的人，眼光也有点异样。张永福脸一黑，本来吃完粉还想把汤喝了。这会儿气得直接就摔筷子。这下场面就变得有些尴尬起来，徐喜弟更是一声不敢吭，站远了好几步。在那里用手给自己的热脸扇风。刘宇宁想了半秒，伸手把徐喜弟吃剩的那小半碗，给拉了过来。“我还没吃饱，两碗又太多，这点刚刚好。”刘宇宁自己吃掉了。张永福这才松了一口气，转头就是一个白眼送给刘烨。刘烨皱了皱眉，这大街上，他就不跟这个小子说道了。他站起身，满足地揉了一圈肚子。“我去修理农具，咱们分头吧，等圩散了，在镇头岔路口汇合。”说完，刘烨拿着东西就走了。张永福冲着他远走的背影哼了一声，想骂老流氓，被刘宇宁眼神制止。……吃饱起来，刘宇宁又重新背上张永福。巴儿姐就跟个调皮的孩童，哪哪都稀奇，哪里人多就往哪里钻。徐喜弟紧跟着她，跑一身汗。刘宇宁也怕她们两个姑娘家，在这热闹的街市，会被有心人盯上，只能背着张永福小跑跟上。去医院的事，谁都没有提半个字。最后倒是买了不少街边小吃，水拐，米饼，糖糖果果。赶一回圩，只有巴儿姐收获满满。直到散圩，张永福刚刚很想买的小乌龟，都被生生错过了。“就不该带她们！一路都全跟着她们跑了！”他坐在背篓里，骂骂咧咧。“就是故意的，故意不给我买东西。”刘宇宁多少有些内疚。来圩上是他主动提议带张永福出来散散心的。没想到最后却让张永福更不开心了。“我这辈子，都不想再跟她们来赶圩了。净跑净跑！”“弟，你别着急，过两天我出来上班，托人给你捎一只回来。”刘宇宁只能这么安慰。“你保证？”张永福还是嘟着嘴，但语气软了一些。“我保证。”刘宇宁保证。“那我们快回家吧，不用等那个老……刘烨了。”张永福看看逐渐冷清的街道，立刻转了话题。刘宇宁不知道为什么张永福对刘烨意见这么大。一向好说话的他，忍不住再次责备张永福。“弟，咱们等他，不仅仅是为了结伴一起回家。”“是相互确保平安，不能这么任性。”“一个村的兄弟，一起出来就要一起回去。”“一个都不能少。”“如果咱们就先回去了，他等不到我们，会以为我们出事了，指不定着急成啥样。”“让他找，急死那个大傻子！”张永福还在嘴硬。刘宇宁摇摇头，实在想不明白，究竟多大的怨？让张永福这么厌恶自己仅有的两位好兄弟之中的其中一人？“那他要是去报公安找我们呢？你不想刚到家，公安就跟着屁股进门吧？”“同样，咱们要是等不到他的人，肯定也要到处找一找。”“不管他和你之间有什么不愉快，出了村，就得抛开私人恩怨，做团结的一家人。”张永福被教育了一通，闷闷缩着脖子，不再说话了。四人刚走到镇口，刘烨就大步追了上来。……回到家，天已经快黑了。范金花看到巴儿姐手里的大包小包，皱起眉头。“你们出门，一分钱都不带，怎么买这么多东西……”又看看一脸郁郁寡欢的张永福。“宇宁，今天给你添麻烦了，又出力气又出钱的。”她把刘宇宁客客气气地送出了门。“没事，婶，是我该做的。”刘宇宁笑着挥汗离开。……夜色降下，徐喜弟再次体验到了六碗粉的不一样。
content_en: Liu Yuning was waiting for Liu Ye and Xu Xidi to catch up.Five people, each with their own thoughts, rushed to the town.The festival day is indeed very lively.They had a long way to go, and when they arrived at the market, it was already filled with farmers selling goods.When Sister Baer saw the first stall selling rice noodles, she just sat there and refused to leave."Brother, let's eat a bowl of noodles first and then go shopping." Zhang Yongfu patted Liu Yuning on the shoulder.In fact, none of the five people had breakfast. It was almost noon when they arrived in town, so they each pulled up a stool and sat down."Grandma, let's have ten bowls of noodles with some lean meat." Liu Yuning took Zhang Yongfu out of the basket, pulled a small bench to place him, called for noodles, and took out five yuan from his trouser pocket."Ten bowls?" The old lady thought she heard wrongly, "Four bowls or ten bowls?" "Ten bowls." Liu Yuning said again.The old lady counted the heads, there were five people, two bowls per person.Thinking about it, it’s wrong. Two of them are women, and each of them can only have one bowl at most.A thin monkey can barely manage a bowl.Her powder is the most generous powder stall on the street.There were two strong men, one slightly stronger than the other.So she took the initiative to assign them.Give Liu Ye four bowls and Liu Yuning three bowls.It is very common for rough men who work in the village to eat two bowls, but it is rare to eat three bowls.The small table in front of the five people was packed with ten bowls of noodles.Pedestrians passing by couldn't help but take a second look.Watching Liu Yuning push the other two bowls in front of Liu Ye... Liu Ye smiled innocently at him and accepted them all, "Thank you." The old lady's eyes widened.This strong man has to cook six bowls of rice noodles by himself!She wanted to see how he could finish eating!Liu Ye did not disappoint her either. He raised the first bowl, curled his chopsticks in the bowl, and then the lion opened his mouth wide.I finished rolling the noodles in the first sip, and drank all the soup in the second sip.Then there is the second bowl, the same steps.In the past few years, they were used to seeing Liu Ye's sloppy behavior while eating, so they were not surprised.Xu Xidi was separated by three people at the far edge. She was far away, and she silently lowered her head to eat her own.My peripheral vision glanced over from time to time.Uncle Silly didn't know how many bowls of rice noodles he had spent on her.And his big mouth didn't let her go from top to bottom... She didn't dare to think about it anymore. It was noon, and the early summer sun was really hot.She was sweating after just taking a small sip of the soup. She wanted to finish it quickly so she could stand up and catch some air.But the rice noodles given by the old lady were so generous that she couldn't eat more than half of them.As soon as she stood up, Liu Ye stared at her bowl accurately from a few people away."Xidi, are you full?" "Yes. You are full." Xu Xidi had a bad feeling."There is so much left, don't waste it. If you can't finish it, give it to your uncle." Liu Ye said and stretched out his hand.But there were three people in the middle and he couldn't reach it, so he touched Liu Yuning's arm.Liu Yuning was stunned, "Brother, would you like to order another bowl?" "No, I'm full. I just don't want to waste food." Liu Ye rejected his kindness.Liu Yuning knew that Liu Ye could eat it, six bowls was enough.If you insist on having another bowl, it won’t be a problem.But the old lady who owned the stall was dumbfounded, and the people around her also looked at it a little strangely.Zhang Yongfu's face darkened. He wanted to drink the soup after finishing the noodles.Now I was so angry that I threw my chopsticks.The scene became a little awkward now, and Xu Xidi did not dare to say a word and stood several steps away.There he fanned his hot face with his hands.Liu Yuning thought for half a second, then reached out and pulled over the small half of Xu Xidi's leftover bowl."I'm not full yet, and two bowls are too much, so this is just right." Liu Yuning ate it himself.Zhang Yongfu breathed a sigh of relief, turned around and gave Liu Ye a roll of his eyes.Liu Ye frowned. He would not talk to this boy on the street.He stood up and rubbed his belly contentedly."I'm going to repair the farm tools. Let's split up and meet at the Zhentou fork when the polder clears." After saying that, Liu Ye took the things and left.Zhang Yongfu snorted at his walking back and wanted to scold the old gangster, but was stopped by Liu Yuning's eyes....When he was full, Liu Yuning put Zhang Yongfu on his back again.Sister Ba'er is just like a naughty child. She is curious about everything and sneaks in wherever there are many people.Xu Xidi followed her closely, sweating all over.Liu Yuning was also afraid that the two girls would be targeted by someone interested in this lively market, so he could only run with Zhang Yongfu on his back to keep up.No one mentioned a word about going to the hospital.In the end, I bought a lot of street snacks, water candies, rice cakes, candies and candies.After a trip to the fair, only Sister Baer gained a lot.Until Sanwei, the little turtle that Zhang Yongfu wanted to buy just now was missed."I shouldn't have taken them with me! I followed them all the way!" He sat in the basket and cursed."It was intentional. He deliberately didn't buy me anything." Liu Yuning felt somewhat guilty.It was he who took the initiative to take Zhang Yongfu out to relax when he came to Weishang.Unexpectedly, it made Zhang Yongfu even more unhappy in the end."I don't want to follow them to catch the fair again in my life. Just run away!" "Brother, don't worry. I will go to work in two days and ask someone to bring one back for you." Liu Yuning could only comfort like this."You promise?" Zhang Yongfu still pouted, but his tone was softer."I promise." Liu Yuning promised."Then let's go home quickly. We don't have to wait for that old... Liu Ye." Zhang Yongfu looked at the gradually deserted streets and immediately changed the subject.Liu Yuning didn't know why Zhang Yongfu had such a big opinion against Liu Ye.He, who was always easy to talk to, couldn't help but blame Zhang Yongfu again."Brother, we are waiting for him not just to go home together." "We want to ensure each other's safety. We can't be so willful." "Brothers from the same village must go back together when they come out together." "No one can be left behind." "If we go back first, if he can't wait for us, he will think something happened to us, and he may be in a hurry." "Let him find him, and he will kill that big fool!" Zhang Yongfu was still talking harshly.Liu Yuning shook his head. He really couldn't understand how big the complaint was.What makes Zhang Yongfu hate one of his only two good brothers so much?"Then what if he reports to the police to look for us? You don't want the police to follow him in the door as soon as you get home, do you?" "Similarly, if we can't wait for him, we will definitely look for him everywhere." "No matter what unpleasantness he has with you, when you leave the village, you must put aside your personal grudges and become a united family." Zhang Yongfu was taught a lesson, and he frowned and stopped talking.As soon as the four of them reached the entrance of the town, Liu Ye stalked after them....When I got home, it was almost dark.Fan Jinhua frowned when she saw the big and small bags in Sister Ba'er's hand."You go out and don't bring a penny with you. Why do you buy so many things..." Then he looked at Zhang Yongfu who looked unhappy."Yuning, I've caused you trouble today, with both effort and money." She politely sent Liu Yuning out the door."It's okay, Auntie, it's what I should do." Liu Yuning left with a smile and sweat.... As night fell, Xu Xidi once again experienced the difference of six bowls of noodles.
